verdict.rationale: Runway Dev documents an HTTP API for video generation. Text-only requests go to `POST /v1/text_to_video` and return a task id, which is polled at `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until it reaches SUCCEEDED or FAILED. The docs also cover an npm SDK and cURL examples, and a probe confirmed the OpenAPI 3.1 spec is published. Missing for 10: an explicit description of how the finished asset is returned or downloaded (e.g. output URLs in the task response), independent hands-on corroboration of the API workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset

citations.quote: send a request to receive a task id, then poll `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until the task reaches `SUCCEEDED` or `FAILED`.
First, you’ll want to install the Runway SDK. You can do this with npm
